title.en: An Act Converting the Sitio of Bagong Silang, Municipality of San Miguel, Province of Bulacan, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Bagong Silang
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitio of Bagong Silang, Municipality of San Miguel, Province of Bulacan, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Bagong Silang
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio Bagong Silang tại Thị trấn San Miguel, Tỉnh Bulacan thành Barrio với tên gọi Barrio Bagong Silang
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ Bagong Silang ในเทศบาล San Miguel จังหวัด Bulacan เป็น บาริโอในชื่อบาริโอ Bagong Silang
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sitio Bagong Silang di Kotamadya San Miguel, Provinsi Bulacan menjadi Barrio dengan nama Barrio Bagong Silang
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio Bagong Silang di Perbandaran San Miguel, Wilayah Bulacan kepada Barrio dengan nama Barrio Bagong Silang

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2098_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Bagong Silang, Municipality of San Miguel, Province of Bulacan, is converted into a barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Bagong Silang.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 28, 1959.
